xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:OriginalObject: Funding the capital expenditure requirements of the Company, including towards expansion and development of Business Units
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureNotesOnObjectsForWhi:
1. Utilisation is in line with the Placement document dated March 13, 2025
2. As disclosed in the Placement Document dated March 13, 2025, an estimated amount of Rs. 44.53 Crores was
allocated towards issue related expenses. However, during the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the actual
expenses incurred were Rs. 35.45 Crores, resulting in an unutilised balance of Rs. 9.08 Crores. Pursuant to the
Board Resolution dated August 07, 2026, the aforesaid balance amount of Rs. 9.08 Crores lying in the QIP
Escrow Account maintained with HSBC Bank was transferred to the QIP Monitoring Account maintained with
HSBC Bank and was accordingly reallocated towards General Corporate Purposes (GCP). Consequent to the
transfer of the unutilized balance of Rs. 9.08 crores, originally earmarked towards issue-related expenses, to
the Monitoring Account for General Corporate Purposes, the net proceeds of the QIP have been revised from
Rs. 2,476.29 crores to Rs. 2,485.37 crores.
3. Gross proceeds is Rs. 2,520.82 Crores and net proceeds is Rs. 2,485.37 Crores, out of which Rs. 634.63 Crores was utilised until the previous quarter ended June 30, 2026 and Rs. 185.48 Crores is utilised in the current quarter ended September 30, 2026, totalling to Rs. 820.11 Crores
